products.title: Home Office - Note - By Matteo Nunziati
products.description_html:
This desk is the result of the desire to create a contemporary product with essential characteristics and very refined aesthetic and technical details that demonstrate the woodworking expertise that Molteni&C. is devoted to maintaining.

The top, positioned asymmetrically on the structure, has two trays carved into its wood surface, and the central tray is covered in saddle leather. The wood on the rear is made with a pronounced curved shape that allows it to hold small drawers, which are also covered in saddle leather. The legs are made with a complex three-dimensional woodworking technique in which grooves are carved into three sides of the piece. The resulting product shows a good balance of essential style and elegance, simultaneously modern and linear while also refined and rich in expert cabinet-making details.

DIMENSIONS:

W. 130 | D. 69,5 | H. 80 |

products.title: Home Office - Desk D.847.1 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
More than 70 years after its original design, the D.847.1 console table is reborn thanks to the Heritage Collection reissue project by Molteni&C, in collaboration with the Gio Ponti Archives.

As with all the projects in the Heritage Collection, careful study of drawings, photos and period materials has made it possible to faithfully reproduce the D.847.1 desk in all its details, bringing to light a masterpiece, inspired by the high level of craftsmanship in solid wood processing.

The desk is characterised by a top with curved ends, resembling an aeroplane wing, and a small drawer underneath with a rounded front - a real innovation, which was to become a hallmark of many Ponti products in the following years

DIMENSIONS:

W. 134 | D. 40 | H. 78,5

products.title: Home Office - Aria - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Aria writing desk by Vincent Van Duysen blends lightness and strength, designed to integrate seamlessly into any living space. With its refined silhouette and meticulous attention to detail, Aria embodies a contemporary aesthetic while offering a highly functional workspace.

Its structure, crafted from painted steel, balances durability with an airy, almost weightless presence. The defining feature—a gracefully folded sheet—lends the desk an architectural purity, complemented by a top surface wrapped in Ecoskin, a sophisticated vegan leather available in ivory, earth, taupe, or dark brown. This seamless covering is expertly affixed via an innovative magnetic system, ensuring a pristine, uninterrupted design.

Beneath the surface, a discreet pull-out drawer enhances functionality, providing a dedicated space for essentials without disrupting the desk’s minimalist form. The lower perimeter, elegantly tapered and crafted from black lacquered solid wood, reinforces the desk’s harmonious balance of materials.
Aria is the perfect addition to a home office or living space, offering both practical usability and understated sophistication.

DIMENSIONS :

W. 140 | D. 70 | H. 72.5 | SD. 55 cm

products.title: Single units - Carteggio - By Aldo Rossi
products.description_html:
A wood writing desk with drawers and pull out top protected by a blind. To organize and rearrange our daytime.

  • (W): 46 cm 

  • (D): 48 cm

products.title: Home Office - Touch Down Unit - By Studio Klass
products.description_html:
Touch Down Unit, an innovative workstation designed by Studio Klass and originally thought for advanced work environments and produced by UniFor, has become part of the Molteni&C collection in its new home version.

TDU, enhanced by a series of new and more homely finishes, has been reinterpreted and conceived as an autonomous, discreet workstation. A safe place where to leave the necessary equipment to carry out your activity, may it be just sending an email or checking your schedule, thus becoming an object designed to meet individual requirements which changes and comes to life as a space for your personal items.

Use your laptop and recharge your electronic devices, thanks to its rechargeable battery equipped with USB sockets.

DIMENSIONS :

  • (W): 86,2 cm 

  • (D): 52,4 cm 

  • (H): 104 cm

products.title: Single Units - Archway - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
The Archway sideboard is a sleek and modern design by one of the primary figures in Molteni&C’s exploration into the world of design, Rodolfo Dordoni, and the latest addition to the extensive collection of furnishings for living.

This piece owes its striking form to a stylish and modern silhouette. The external facets are enriched by a glossy lacquered finish, while the top can be customized in marble or wood. The door is embellished with a slightly cantilevered metal profile in relation to the top, which traces the handle with a strong line. In the center, an open compartment with a drawer provides a central volume creating a sense of movement. The sideboard’s clean lines and the play of thicknesses between the structure and the doors give it a minimal and contemporary look and feel.

Archway is available in two lengths, 242 cm and 270cm, while the plinth is 18cm in height and hides an integrated drawer, allowing for added versatility within the design. Beautifully finished on both sides, it can be placed against a wall or in the center of a room, providing enhanced flexibility.

The sideboard can be customized in any of the Molteni&C glossy lacquered shades, including the new Pine Green and Almond White colors, creating infinite possibilities for harmonizing with any interior palette. The wood and marble varieties for the top include gold-toned limba or coffee oak, recognizable for its intense streaks, and calacatta, sahara noir and nero marquina marble with a matte or glossy polyester finish — a wide array of options for customizing the overall aesthetic.

The console’s internal compartments give the piece its most prominent detail. Cut at a 45-degree angle, it offers a uniquely contemporary look that is perfect for the dining room or living area. A unique and stunning piece of furniture that achieves aesthetic originality through technological innovation, the sideboard is the perfect blend of style, functionality, and personalization. Archway makes an excellent addition to any modern home or hospitality space.

products.title: Single Units - MHC.2 - By Yasuhiko Itoh
products.description_html: MHC.2 is a re-edition of the bookcase prototype designed in 1959 by Yasuhiko Itoh. Made in curved wood, a complex process for that time period, it won an award at the 3rd edition of the Selettiva competition in Cantù del 1959. This piece is both elegant and refined. After issuing a limited edition run of 100 numbered pieces, this item is now available as a standard, non-numbered piece in curved wood covered in walnut.

products.title: Single Units - Horizons - By Dante Bonuccelli
products.description_html:
With Horizons, a cupboard for the daytime area, Dante Bonuccelli proposes a different way of storing, and at the same time displaying much-loved objects.

Two tip-up doors, which, when closed, reveal the contents thanks to both the transparent stopsol glass and the internal LED lighting, and when open, folded back against the side of the piece for full access to the internal space, transform the cupboard like a chameleon.

products.title: Single Units - MHC.1 - By Werner Blaser
products.description_html:
MHC.1 is a new edition of the prototype of the first modern piece of furniture made by Molteni&C, the chest of drawers designed by Werner Blaser. Thought it was never produced industrially, in 1955 it won first prize at the Cantù “Prima mostra selettiva - Concorso internazionale del mobile”, a competition designed to re-qualify the image of Italian furniture making. The jury was made up of Gio Ponti, Alvar Alto, Romano Barocchi, Carlo de Carli and Finn Juhl. The unusual joinery features a simple three-fork joint.

After issuing a limited edition run of 100 numbered pieces, two new non-numbered versions are available in the new finishes honey pattern wood and black ash wood.

Dimensions

100x45x75H cm

products.title: Single Units - Adrien - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Adrien expresses a desire to present a new series of storage units, conceptually avant-garde both in technological and in aesthetic terms. Adrien is a fortunate combination of purity of form and exclusive materials and technologies, blended harmoniously and with a focus on key visual and tactile aspects. This new system of storage units develops the concept of rigorous containers defined by absolute transparency.

In Adrien the structural aluminium thickness is reduced to a minimum, allowing the Stopsol glass and the built-in LED lighting system of the shelves to enhance the appeal of the objects displayed. A four door configuration with just one height. The back panel can be made of wood or glass to highlight the complete transparency of the object. The door, made of Stopsol glass or transparent opens thanks to a new patented 95° hinge.

products.title: Single Units - Piroscafo - By Aldo Rossi & Luca Meda
products.description_html:
Molteni&C presents a new version of the Piroscafo for the 30th Anniversary. A new facade lacquered in a warm Spice colour with eucalyptus interiors re-proposes a classic piece in a contemporary version without betraying its origins as a rigorous but functional piece of furniture.

On a cold afternoon, two friends, Luca Meda and Aldo Rossi, are walking through the Fontivegge Centre, the headquarters of the Umbria Regional Council. The two friends were talking animatedly and suddenly stopped to look at the large green glass facade next to the former Perugina chimney, a true relic of industrial archaeology. It was the moment of intuition: take the building’s facade and transform it into furniture!

In a few months, their intuition became reality. At the 1991 Salone del Mobile, four large compositions were presented, two with a white façade and two in Prussian green, which stood out in the centre of the Molteni&C stand. In 1993, based on an idea by Luca Meda, at the Salone del Mobile, a gigantic Piroscafo, 13 metres long, complete with red and black funnels reproducing a real ship, welcomed visitors.

products.title: Single Units - D.655.1 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
Marked by hand-painted white drawer fronts with applied handles in various wood kinds (elm, Italian walnut, mahogany and rosewood).
Chest of drawers designed in several versions in the period from 1952 to 1955. The new version was produced using original drawings kept in the Gio Ponti Archives and the art direction for the Gio Ponti Collection came from Studio Cerri & Associati.The elmwood frame rests on satin brass feet. The chest of drawers must be securely fixed to the wall.

W. 185 | D. 52 | H. 89,9 cm

products.description_html:
Marked by hand-painted white drawer fronts with applied handles in various wood kinds (elm, Italian walnut, mahogany and rosewood).
Chest of drawers designed in several versions in the period from 1952 to 1955. products.title: Single Units - Living Box - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Living Box, designed by Vincent Van Duysen: starting from a typically architectural project such as a building, a stage for concerts and conferences, or a monumental space, Vincent Van Duysen reduced its scale, transforming it into a household object with particular features and the possibility of new uses.

Living Box was conceived as an independent item of furniture, usable in any room of the house, but mainly suitable for the living room. Despite its reduced size, it retains the rigour and monumentality of the building it derives from, accentuating its details by means of quality materials. Living Box expands its repertoire with an enhanced storage solution: the introduction of sliding "Stripe" doors, similar to those found in Molteni&C Kitchen Dada Engineered kitchens. These doors, crafted with a wood frame and central glass, enclose the interior space, creating private sections while preserving the elegance of the design. Additionally, LED lighting can now be integrated into the vertical sides, producing a refined illumination effect that highlights the inner structure.

Low yet expansive (230, 280, 330, 380) Living Box is defined by contrasting materials that make up its exterior and interior. The top features marble and different woods, specially arranged to decorate the surface. The entire composition is enclosed within an iris and pewter frame, thread-like if seen from above, but forming a thick profile surrounding the inside space if seen from the front.

The top can be fitted and integrated with trunking, useful for facilitating connections of any kind between multimedia equipment, TVs, or lighting fixtures. The remaining space can be left free or used to display artistic or personal ornaments.

The inside space, recalling a "magical cave," features numerous surprises. The woods used, including Eucalyptus and the new Sunrise Oak finish, completely envelop and mark the perimeter. Sunrise Oak revisits a classic theme with a contemporary touch, offering warmth and tactile softness. This light-toned finish is skillfully achieved through expert craftsmanship, enhanced by irregular brushing—a time-honored process reinterpreted in a modern key.

Sunrise Oak is like the revisitation of a classic theme reinterpreted with a contemporary taste, without excluding accents of warmth and tactile softness. The new finish, featuring a very light shade skillfully achieved by our expert cabinet makers, is further enhanced by the particular way in which the wood is irregularly brushed according to a time-honoured process reinvented in a modern key.

Suffused lighting is provided by LEDs, and with vertical lighting option, the visual impact is further enriched. The interior space remains free and devoid of sharp corners, thanks to special curved corner-covers, allowing for flexible display options. If this scenographic solution does not fit the purpose, one or more sets of drawers with an iris and pewter or wood finish can be introduced. These drawers offer a discreet yet elegant storage solution, concealing useful items while maintaining a refined aesthetic.

The self-standing drawer sets can be positioned anywhere in the room, allowing for multiple configurations—small architectural elements within a larger shell. The system is completed with a technical Tape container designed to accommodate video and Hi-Fi equipment, seamlessly integrating functionality with aesthetics.

products.title: Single Units - Andromeda - By LSM
products.description_html:
A testament to refined craftsmanship and material innovation, the Andromeda sideboard emerges from the collaboration between UniFor and LSM, enriching the Molteni&C collection with a statement of elegance and precision. Conceived within the evocative setting of the Andromeda Theater in Sicily, this piece embodies the synthesis of aesthetic purity and cutting-edge construction.

Andromeda’s defining characteristic is the seamless fusion of two noble materials— shiny stainless steel and black back-painted stopsol glass —crafted and assembled with impeccable precision, free from visible joints. Its fixed configuration enhances its sculptural presence, featuring four compartments with central hinged doors and a lateral shelf that subtly extends its functional and visual impact.

The entire structure is anchored by a stainless steel “cusp” section, with tapered edges that lend an ethereal lightness to its form. A distinctive base, positioned along the inner sides, creates the illusion of a floating presence, supported only by its lateral wings. The black back-painted stopsol glass top refines the composition, harmonizing strength with sophistication.

products.title: Single Units - Teorema - By Ron Gilad
products.description_html:
The Teorema project is the solid part of a void. It is the mould as design, the template transferred and shifted that becomes micro architecture, and exceeds all disciplinary boundaries.

Ron Gilad turns the chest of drawers featuring rotating elements in space into a storage unit where containment and open glass parts are stacked to create a single solid with a densely faceted surface.

The drawers can be placed in axis or unusually offset at 20° to the rest of the unit.

A unit made of American walnut with open compartments or drawers used as a single unit or stacked in a linear or offset mode, to create night tables, chests of drawers or modular systems for the living area.

products.title: Island - Baltimora - By Matteo Nunziati
products.description_html:
Baltimora is a double-sided island unit designed to be placed in the center of a room. Versatile and eclectic, it can adapt to any location in the bedroom, creating either a unique standalone element or a dynamic dialogue with existing wardrobes or cabinets.

This piece is extremely functional and is designed for dual purposes: to store objects in the bedroom and — thanks to the bench and soft cushions configurable in any Molteni&C fabric or leather — to create an inviting seating area. The two drawers beneath the bench may be used as an additional storage element.

With its soft and rounded lines, the island is composed of a transparent glass top with a frame crafted from pewter, bronze, and iris. Alternatively, the top can be made from eco-skin with a eucalyptus structure, onto which the customizable cushions are placed. The Baltimora Island is ideal for storage, display, and seating — and for adding a touch of elegance to the dressing area.

products.title: Island - Gliss Master Island - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Gliss Master Island is a central island unit, a free-standing element that completes the wardrobe area of a walk-in closet or a closet area.
Storage trays, drawers with clear glass fronts, and elegant shelves finished in eco skin are just some of the distinctive elements.

products.title: Walk-in closets - Dwell - By R&D
products.description_html:
Dwell is a system of sliding doors and partitions designed to close the Gliss Walk-In closets.
The system can be used in the ceiling, wall (side), and recessed (false ceiling).

products.title: Walk-in closets - Hector Night - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Hector Night is a new project dedicated to the night area by Molteni&C. It originates from the Hector bookcase which features a strong modern and flexible expressive character.
Conceived as a perfectly modelled wall system that is also easy to modify and transform, Hector Night is a protagonist of contemporary furniture as an extraordinary expression of the brand’s research in the field of systems.

Hector Night is embellished with infinite features, allowing floor-to-ceiling or wallmounted compositions to be freely organised. As with all the bedroom systems, the common thread running through the double metal finish of the pewter and bronze structure is a perfect match for the sophisticated dark and light chestnut veneered materials of the drawer units and the screen-printed smoked glass top.

In order to remain faithful to the concepts of practicality and functionality without forgetting the elegance and refinement of the details, each shelf can be customised, using either, glass, melamine or ecoskin panels.

products.title: Walk-in closets - Master Dressing- By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Following the success of Gliss Master, Vincent Van Duysen has designed Master Dressing, a walk-in wardrobe system that completes the wide range of nightime systems offered by Molteni&C. Master Dressing perfectly complements the Gliss Master wardrobes thanks to the use of coordinated internal fittings and aesthetic finishes, thereby providing functional and impactful walk-in closets.

Fine grain is a new, sumptuous and exclusive lacquer finish on a printed surface that can also be used for drawer back and front. An exclusive Molteni&C design - starting from a gold base, five coats of varnish are applied with special intermediate satinising and sanding.

The system is fitted with newly designed shelf support rods that will take 30 mm thick Ecopelle and illuminated glass shelves, or 40 mm thick wooden shelves. Newly designed sets of drawers, new tie and foulard rack accessories.

products.title: Walk-in closets - Gliss Master- By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Gliss Master, a one of kind wardrobe system with a bespoke approach, offers maximum customization to fit individual needs, revolutionizing the concept of containment and organization of space. Such tailor-made design allows for a wide selection of doors, accessories and finishes to create an entirely unique world. Bold yet traditional color choices, recessed lighting, and easy accessibility provide a sense of calm to start and finish your day.

The Gliss Master wardrobe system, the pride of the Molteni&C Night Collection, has been given a new look and feel.

Soft Line Accessories surpasses the concept of a solid element to propose a system of soft ecoskin containers. Bags of all sizes hang from structures with sliding aluminium racks, which guarantee perfect accessibility. They thus take their shape from the contents: shirt bags, underclothes bags, accessories such as belts, handbags and shoes, just like the traditional trouser or skirt holders and the pull-out shelves.

The exclusive frame structure of the Gliss Master has been embellished with an elegant ecoskin covering that profiles the front of the frames and shelves, warming up the metallic rigour of pewter and bronze. The ecoskin range is enriched with three new finishes in warm, contemporary colours, to create furnishing solutions for sophisticated customers who pay attention to fine details.

products.title: Islands - Gliss Master Modular Island - By R&D
products.description_html:
Gliss Master Modular Island is designed to seamlessly adapt to the needs of any wardrobe space. Retaining the signature modules and internal compartments of the Gliss Master system, it optimizes organization while maintaining a harmonious aesthetic with wardrobe finishes. The structure is available in wood, melamine, or matte lacquer, allowing for a refined and cohesive look.

Functionality meets design with the Hold handle on the drawer fronts, enhancing ease of use while complementing the island’s elegant lines. Available in various configurations with 3, 4, or 5 drawers, it offers flexible height options to suit different spaces. As the centerpiece of the wardrobe, the Modular Island is thoughtfully designed with a dual-side solution, ensuring optimal usability from both sides.

Fully customizable in size and configuration, the island’s top can match the structure’s finish or be selected in contrasting materials, such as Ecoskin in all available colors. A versatile and sophisticated addition, the Gliss Master Modular Island is the perfect blend of functionality and refined design, bringing effortless organization to Vincent Van Duysen’s signature wardrobe solution.

products.title: Living systems and bookshelves  - Logos - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Modularity, functionality, and lightness are what inspired Molteni&C's first fully modular living room wall unit system.

Designed by Vincent Van Duysen, Logos offers a fresh approach to how space can be designed, offering endless configurations to suit individual tastes and functional needs. With unparalleled versatility and customization, both in composition and finishes, the sleek vertical dividers of Logos adapt effortlessly to any setting.

The storage module of Logos is fully customizable, offering options such as open compartments, doors, or drawers of varying heights, adding both practicality and aesthetic appeal.

The beauty of Logos comes from a sophisticated mix of wood, lacquer, glass, and metal finishes, with further optional customization including bronze mirrors, fabric from the “Blend” collection, and illumination with warm 2700 lumen LED top lighting. Logos takes full advantage of vertical flexibility, reaching a maximum of 125cm to suit the functionality of any wall area.

Whether placed on the ground, mounted on the wall, or suspended with a trestle base in metal finishes, Logos is available in modules ranging from widths of 45cm, 60cm, 75cm, and 90cm, heights of 36cm, 51cm, 62cm, 125cm, all with a universal depth of 50cm.

There is also the option to select a metallic frame that encircles the upper shelf, adding a refined touch to the design with a change in texture.

The upper drawer discreetly conceals cables, devices, or multimedia accessories, adding both practicality and aesthetic appeal.

products.title: Living systems and bookshelves  - 505 UP System - By Nicola Gallizia
products.description_html:
The 505 UP system, a hallmark in Molteni&C's range of modular furniture for living areas, continues its evolution to cater to contemporary lifestyle demands. Born not only as a project for furniture but also for architecture, it creates space and plays with geometries reminiscent of buildings in a city.

Presenting new compositional possibilities, the "Stripe" door, featured in Molteni&C's Dada Engineered kitchens with a wood frame and central glass, is now available to complete both the Display and Harry’s Bar modules. The "Stripe" door finishes are available in all the woods from the 505 collection, offering a wide range of choices to meet both aesthetic and functional needs.

The 505 UP system features the optional inclusion of Calacatta Vena Vecchia textured ceramic, a material that has garnered increasing attention over time. Initially highlighted within the Harry's Bar module, this ceramic boasts a 4mm thickness, offering both durability and aesthetic allure. It seamlessly integrates with the melamine panel serving as its support, a material utilized in all back panels of the 505 system as well as in the Display module back panels.

The functionality of the 505 UP System transcends the traditional bookcase, morphing into a modern furniture piece that complements contemporary living concepts. Introducing a TV holder back with a veined wood panel adds further versatility to its design. Tailored to individual preferences, the 505 Up expands its repertoire beyond conventional bookcase functions. This is exemplified by the introduction of Display, an innovative protruding cabinet that enhances compositional and stylistic flexibility with its grid of horizontal and vertical shelves.

In 2023, Nicola Gallizia introduced a new door design featuring a full-height handle, adding an embellishing profile to the layout. Finishes such as coffee oak and an exclusive customizable 3D effect further enhance the system's aesthetic range.

The 505 UP Harry’s Bar module, conceived by Nicola Gallizia, revitalizes a classic element of living spaces: the mobile bar. Designed as a self-contained unit, it seamlessly integrates into the 505 system.

Featuring large doors with concealed hinges, the internal compartment offers storage for drink-related paraphernalia, ranging from tools to bottles, with options for wooden, ceramic, or Ecoskin coverings. Equipped with shelves, compartments, and drawers, the Harry’s Bar module facilitates the organization of essentials for the bar while maintaining an elegant aesthetic.

With a top surface and pull-out tray, the Harry’s Bar module provides a practical workspace for bartenders, complete with integrated LED lighting to illuminate the preparation area. 505 UP presents a TV holder back, featuring a panel available in veined wood.

The 505 Up is tailored to users’ needs and goes beyond classic bookcase functions, expanding its solutions thanks to the introduction of Display, a new and original protruding cabinet that allows the grid of horizontal and vertical shelves to be moved with maximum compositional and stylistic versatility.

products.title: Wardrobe - Beauté - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
In the 2023 collection, the Milanese designer Rodolfo Dordoni also presents Beauté, a new vanity that can be added to the Blend configuration - or across all other proposals - to create additional functional and discreet spaces. Beauté is both an intimate and elegant space designed to hide the most personal items from view.

The lateral sections in eucalyptus or graphite oak are the setting for a backrest and a top in eco-skin; two side drawers, characterised by a thin edge in wood, further define the volumes. At the centre is a backlit folding mirror which, when opened, reveals rear shelves complete with integrated LED lighting. Practical USB sockets complete the accessories. The vanity module can be used in combination with Blend or with other pieces of the Gliss Master collection.

products.title: Wardrobe - Gliss Master-Start - By Molteni&C R&D
products.description_html:
The Start door with its linear design makes it possible to create solutions with hinged, sliding or flush sliding doors. All types of openings have shock absorbers to facilitate opening and closing.

The Internet Of Things joins the world of Molteni&C nighttime systems – Gliss Master and Masterdressing – with avant-garde solutions and innovations that guarantee wardrobes the best environmental quality. For taking care of clothing and accessories it is, in fact, essential to be able to exclude the presence of harmful agents – bacteria, moulds and allergens – that naturally insinuate themselves onto fabrics in contact with the environment.

products.title: Wardrobe - Gliss Master - Grip - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Grip allows solutions with hinged, sliding and flush sliding doors. The handle, die-cast moulded, is applied to the side of the door and is available in pewter finish or pewter covered in eco skin.

The Internet Of Things joins the world of Molteni&C nighttime systems – Gliss Master and Masterdressing – with avant-garde solutions and innovations that guarantee wardrobes the best environmental quality. For taking care of clothing and accessories it is, in fact, essential to be able to exclude the presence of harmful agents – bacteria, moulds and allergens – that naturally insinuate themselves onto fabrics in contact with the environment.

Gliss Master, “Grip” hinged doors, handles pewter colour, clothes rail and led lighting bar.

“Grip” hinged doors silica cartapaglia and handles pewter colour.

products.title: Accessories - Ueno - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Ueno screen, in line with the Timeout collection, is characterised by its burnished metal frame and hand-woven polypropylene cord in the colour anthracite. A decorative element that helps modulate the space, adding a discreet touch of style to every outdoor environment.

Thanks to its interplay of material and structural references, it can be used both with the elements of the Timeout Collection and with the entire Outdoor Collection. In addition to the screen, the range includes a large array of products, such as the sofa, the dining table with seats, the comfortable lounger, side tables, stools and bench.

products.title: Accessories - Boulogne - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Practical, lightweight and easily movable baskets for towels or magazines are designed to create order and embellish outdoor spaces.

They take up the weave theme common to the two outdoor collections, here expressed in the simple warp and weft motif, made of strips of the same size as Hyde pouffe. For reasons of resistance, the baskets are made entirely of olive-green EVA polyurethane.

The baskets are available in three sizes and in a rectangular shape so that they can be stacked when empty to minimise clutter. The first product in a range of accessories that will grow in the future, the baskets show the search, underlying Molteni&C's outdoor collections, for all-round comfort that invites relaxation and conviviality, where every element has its place.

products.title: Stool - Pantalica - By Elisa Ossino
products.description_html:
Designed to serve as seating or to be used as small tables, the Pantalica stools by Elisa Ossino offer a compelling accent to outdoor living areas. Their minimalistic shapes are inspired by archaic forms drawn from the ancient cultures of the Mediterranean basin, creating an aesthetic that evokes a rustic and timeless feel. Named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily, the Pantalica collection interprets influences from antiquity for contemporary outdoor spaces.

The two stool designs are crafted on a sturdy aluminum base embellished by a carefully woven rattan made of polypropylene, a weatherproof material that is also fully circular. Each of the two stools offers a unique interpretation of the multifunctional concept.

One variation features four cylindrical bases with a cube-shaped top. The other stands upon a single cylindrical base and features a square-shaped top.
With their supple synthetic rattan tops, the stools do not require a cushion when used as a seating solution.
The Pantalica stools are an elegant complement to the Pantalica daybed, Pantalica coffee table, Pantalica rug, and all other designs from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection.

products.title: Stool - Green Point - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
More compact in its seating dimensions, the stool from the Timeout Collection has a slender structure, characterised by a flat band in burnished painted aluminium with no corners. Seen in profile, the slender thickness of the band gives the stool a delicate, airy silhouette, contrasting with the dense, textured upholstery in the traditional weave pattern that characterises the entire Timeout Collection. To maximise seating comfort, the backrest is calibrated to properly support the kidneys, while the metal band is also repeated between the two sled bases, creating a comfortable footrest.

DIMENSIONS :

W. 52 | D. 54 | H. 105 cm

products.title: Rug - Pantalica - By Elisa Ossino
products.description_html:
The Pantalica rug by Elisa Ossino embellishes the outdoor space with an artistic touch. Drawing inspiration from ancient Mediterranean cultures and landscapes, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

Specially crafted for exterior use, this rug channels timeless aesthetics into a design that harmonizes seamlessly with the entire Molteni&C Outdoor Collection.

Unevenly cut strips of weather-resistant polypropylene are loosely woven, allowing air and light to pass through while creating uneven edging that lends a compelling finish to the rug. The Pantalica rug complements the Pantalica daybed, Pantalica coffee table, Pantalica stools, and all other designs from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection for a harmonious composition.

Contact us for custom sizes.

products.title: Rug - Palma - By Nicola Gallizia

products.title: Sunbed - Pantalica - By Elisa Ossino
products.description_html:
Balancing sinuous curves with elegant linearity, the Pantalica daybed by Elisa Ossino brings a sculptural form to outdoor lounge areas. Rooted in rustic Mediterranean inspiration, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

This chaise longue design is influenced by archaic forms, harkening back to the ancient cultures of Sicily and the Mediterranean basin. The daybed is crafted from materials that can be reintroduced to the production cycle at the end of life, making this distinctive piece a circular design.

Built upon a sturdy aluminum base, the Pantalica daybed is carefully woven with weatherproof polypropylene rattan, infusing the piece with a natural look and feel that is preserved across time.

A cylindrical motif defines the cushions for a visually compelling effect that is also highly ergonomic, enhancing the comfort of the daybed. Held in place by an EVA strap, the headrest is the ideal shape for supporting the neck, while the liner cushion molds to the contours of the body.

Fully removable, the cushion covers are available in any fabric from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection.

The Pantalica daybed can be complemented by the Pantalica coffee table, Pantalica stools, Pantalica rug, and all other designs from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection for a harmonious composition.

products.title: Sunbed - Guell - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The sunbed, the archetype par excellence of outdoor furniture, interprets all the elements that characterise the aesthetics of the Timeout Collection, re-proposing the theme of the burnished painted aluminium band, running along the entire profile, and the traditional motif of the polypropylene rope weave.

The wooden slats are the same width as those of the 6- or 8-seater table, supporting that refined interplay of dimensional recurrences that links the products of the same collection or between the two families of outdoor furniture.

The sunbed is lightweight and can be easily moved thanks to the wheel fitted to the backrest. To ensure maximum safety, the wheel is positioned barely suspended, being activated only when the sunbed is raised. This is one of the many details that underlines the design precision of the Collection.

products.title: Bench - Regis - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Regis is the perfect representation of practicality and versatility. Whether used as additional seating or as a footrest, this elegant and functional stool effortlessly transforms into a pouf. Regis adds a touch of elegance to any space, creating a warm and inviting environment for guests to relax at their leisure.

Crafted with a burnished metal base of three polished legs and circular frame, Regis exudes understated sophistication. The seat, custom upholstered in luxurious vegetable-tanned leather or carefully curated textiles by designer Marta Ferri, ensures both comfort and style. Vincent Van Duysen describes Regis as "a timeless piece with enduring appeal," reflecting its ability to transcend trends and complement any interior with grace.

Measuring 48cm in diameter and 45cm in height, Regis blends form and versatility. Its circular yet structured design allows it to seamlessly integrate into various settings, serving as a connecting element between pieces like the Augusto and Lucio sofas from the 2024 collection.

products.title: Outdoor Side Table - Picea - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Picea coffee table, a Vincent Van Duysen design, is a seamless addition to the Outdoor Timeout Collection. Crafted entirely in ceramic, Picea boasts gracefully rounded lines and a harmonious design, echoing the natural beauty of the Arctic evergreen spruce tree from which it takes its name.

Picea’s slight hourglass shape offers a wider base and a comfortable support surface, evoking a sense of movement without disrupting the fluidity of its solid color body. This design language speaks of sophistication, eschewing unnecessary complexity while embracing a robust presence.

Available in three timeless colors—Ecru, Anthracite, and Merlot Red—the Picea coffee table offers versatility in design and aesthetic appeal. With dimensions of 34.5 cm in diameter and 45 cm in height, it stands as a symbol of understated elegance in any outdoor setting.

Whether as a duo, a cluster, or a standalone piece, Picea coffee tables invite exploration and creativity. Monochrome or mixed, they elevate outdoor spaces with their timeless charm and enduring allure.

Diameter: 34,5 cm

Height: 45 cm

products.title: Bench - Green Point - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
A multipurpose element with an accentuated horizontal nature, the bench lends itself well to the freedom of use and mobility inherent in outdoor furniture.

Among the Timeout Collection, it is the element that most explicitly expresses the contrast between the minimalist and contemporary aesthetics of the structure, formed by the continuous running of the burnished painted aluminium band, and the more traditional motif of the upholstery, created with a handmade weave of polypropylene rope.

In the bench, the rounded profile of the band at the horizontal crosspiece is also particularly noteworthy. This detail is designed to maximise seating comfort, but also to enhance the image of softness and lightness of the metal structure. The Golden Gate bench is available in three variants: anthracite, olive green and desert yellow. In addition to the bench, the range includes a large array of products, such as the sofa, the dining table with seats, the stool, the comfortable sunbed and side tables.

(W): 140 cm 

(D): 50 cm

products.title: Chair - Cobea - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Cobea chair by Vincent van Duysen is a celebration of timeless design and meticulous artistry. A continuation of the designer’s strong vision for outdoors, the chair pays homage to nature and natural elements, interpreting the beauty of solid teak wood in a contemporary manner.

With options available both with and without armrests, the Cobea chair exudes a minimalist aesthetic, providing a canvas for the chair's clean lines and delicate design to shine. The chair’s defining feature is its backrest, intricately woven with polypropylene fiber ribbons. This detailing creates a soft finish and invites a tactile experience reminiscent of cotton, elevating the chair's appeal.
Supported on solid teak slats, the seat cushion can be customized with a variety of fabrics and colors from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection, meticulously curated by Marta Ferri.
Whether with or without armrests, the Cobea chair is a versatile and stylish addition to outdoor spaces.

products.title: Chair - Green Point - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Timeout Collection offers a wide range of seating: in addition to the two-cushion sofa in two sizes, there is also a generously proportioned armchair and a table chair with a slender.

In the seating, the theme of the band of burnished painted aluminium, the fil rouge of the collection, is taken up again in a more leisurely rhythm to create the structure. The bending of the band draws the shape of the backrest and sled bases, with dynamic, agile and angular profiles. A dense, handcrafted polypropylene rope cover is woven onto the metal frame in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow.

products.title: Dining Table - Fairmount - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Vincent Van Duysen brings his visionary touch to the outdoors with the Fairmount table, a meticulously crafted piece that embraces natural settings with elegance. Designed for the Landmark Collection, Fairmount seamlessly combines comfort and style, creating a captivating centerpiece for social gatherings.

Crafted from exquisite solid teak, the Fairmount table highlights Molteni&C expertise in woodwork, merging the luxurious essence of teak with the emotional language of the Landmark Collection. The tabletop, available in rectangular or round shapes, presents a graceful interplay between substance and lightness.

In the rectangular version, Fairmount subtly references Vincent Van Duysen's Golden Gate table, featuring a base with two rectangular legs. The challenge lies in the suspended planks, ingeniously arranged to create a mesmerizing labyrinthine geometric figure, giving the illusion of a "floating" tabletop with a clever inclination.

Fairmount’s round-top version adopts a Y-shaped base, fostering a sense of conviviality and intimacy. The three solid beams extending from a central junction embrace the sociability associated with the round shape, making it an ideal choice for outdoor occasions.

Fairmount's dimensions cater to various preferences: Rectangular sizes include 220 cm and 280 cm lengths, both with a height of 74 cm. The round version boasts a 160 cm diameter, also standing at 74 cm height, while the tea table measures 120 cm in diameter with a height of 64 cm.

This outdoor table is not only a visual delight but also a practical, low-maintenance choice. Crafted from raw materials sourced from controlled supply chains, Fairmount preserves the natural color of the wood without resorting to chemical treatments or harmful substances. The teakwood's high percentage of oily resin makes maintenance a breeze, requiring only periodic oiling using the dedicated maintenance kit provided by Molteni&C. Fairmount's monomateriality contributes to its sustainability, making it an excellent choice for those who appreciate a harmony of style and environmental consciousness.

products.title: Outdoor Dining Table - Arc - By Foster + Partners
products.description_html:
Foster + Partners' Arc sculpture table joins the outdoor proposal with an all-cement finish.

The shape of the base is inspired by the techno-structures often used in modern buildings, while the material used is a "light" cement that incorporates colour and a special fibrous material, moulded in a single block and coloured en masse. The result is a strong structure, characterised by a low specific weight, which makes it possible to create complex shapes.

The Arc table combines structural characteristics of strength and elasticity with innovative concepts such as complete recyclability and the low environmental impact of the production cycle. The outdoor proposal, which is configured in a single dimension, is available in the colour anthracite in all its components, resulting in a sculptural table with a mono-material and monochrome essence.

products.title: Dining Table - Golden Gate - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Timeout Collection dining table interprets the archetype of outdoor tables with a slatted top for water drainage. Seating 6 or 8, it stands out for its carefully calibrated proportions and choice of materials that allow it to match both of Molteni&C's new outdoor collections.

The structure takes up the motif of the burnished aluminium band, with its rounded profile and without corners. As in the entire Timeout Collection, the support bases are sled-shaped, created by the continuous movement of the same metal band and here positioned flush with the top as a natural continuation of it.

The top is available in two versions: in solid teak slats or in slabs of lava stone in the three colours - anthracite, olive green and desert yellow - with a slightly rough surface that evokes its lithic nature. The vitreous inserts of the Etna lava stone, used for the oven-baked enamelling of the surfaces, come from the crushing of recycled glass from TV and PC monitors.

products.title: Coffee Table - Sway - By Yabu Pushelberg
products.description_html:
Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Sway outdoor coffee table by Yabu Pushelberg exudes warmth and natural charm.

The series of coffee tables, available in three sizes, features the same aesthetic motifs as the Sway family, presenting a harmonious and customizable addition. Perfect for serving refreshments or displaying decorative accents, this small coffee table is designed to enhance the overall ambiance and style.

It is available with a natural teak wood finish, with a sleek ceramic finish or with a fabric inclusion, bringing an elegant texture to the tabletop for both style and functionality.

products.title: Coffee Table - Pantalica - By Elisa Ossino
products.description_html:
Blending a natural aesthetic with circular materials that preserve their character over time, the Pantalica coffee table by Elisa Ossino is a sculptural centerpiece for the outdoor living area. Inspired by Mediterranean landscapes and the cultures that inhabited them in antiquity, the Pantalica collection is named after the famous UNESCO World Heritage Site in southeastern Sicily.

The rounded design is influenced by archaic forms, echoing the art that emerged at the dawn of civilization, and that continues to resonate today.

The coffee table’s sturdy aluminum frame is shaped into four cylindrical bases and a circular tabletop, all embellished by carefully woven synthetic rattan made of polypropylene. Evoking a natural look and feel, the woven material is fully weatherproof.

The Pantalica coffee table can be combined with the stools of the same collection in a cluster to enhance the sculptural composition.

The Pantalica daybed, Pantalica stools, Pantalica rug, and all other designs from the Molteni&C Outdoor Collection offer an elegant complement to the Pantalica coffee table.

products.title: Outdoor Coffee Table - Panna Cotta - By Ron Gilad
products.description_html:
Panna Cotta, designed by Ron Gilad, represents a combination of delicacy and stability; there is a paradox in the use of materials such as marble and iron to achieve a fragile solidity.

The coffee table is characterised by a slight vibration of the top reminiscent of the typical Italian dessert, from which it takes its name.

In its outdoor guise, Panna Cotta features a stainless-steel frame with a perforated top, supporting a base in Lava Stone. The vitreous inserts of the Etna lava stone, used for the oven-baked enamelling of the surfaces, come from the crushing of recycled glass from TV and PC monitors. The coffee table is available in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow is available in two rounded tops.

products.title: Outdoor Coffee Table - Regent - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Vincent Van Duysen designed the Regent coffee tables with three top shapes: round, oval and square. The size of the tops is inversely proportional to the height of the coffee tables, allowing them to fit into each other, creating islands of elements side by side. The round one is also designed to be placed above the sofas in the two collections, providing a useful shelf.

A common and distinctive element of the Regent series is the ring-shaped base. With its slender, minimalist profile, it is made up of two burnished painted aluminium frames: one supporting the top and one at the base, which incorporates, with a refined slotted movement, the two vertical support rods. The base is the result of a profound and careful attention to detail, to the mechanisms for joining the elements and to a precise study of proportions.

The rounded shape of the tops, which have no edges, and the theme of the metal band, here in a vertical rather than horizontal position, cite both the compositional fil rouge of the Timeout Collection and the organicity of the lines underlying the Landmark Collection.

Similarly, the chromatic and material recurrence of the burnished metal and the top in Etna lava stone, give the Regent coffee tables a sense of continuity between the two collections.

The vitreous inserts of the Etna lava stone, used for the oven-baked enamelling of the surfaces, come from the crushing of recycled glass from TV and PC monitors.

products.title: Coffee Table - Phoenix - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html: Completing the Timeout Collection is a large low table in two widths, for versatile, intimate or convivial outdoor living spaces. It picks up on the aesthetic motifs of the collection such as the burnished aluminium band, profiles and rounded corners. The support bases, obtained from the continuous run of the same band, are set back from the top to make it visually lighter, as if suspended.

products.title: Armchair - Phoenix - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Timeout Collection offers a wide range of seating: in addition to the two-cushion sofa in two sizes, there is also a generously proportioned armchair and a table chair with a slender, aerial profile, both available with or without armrests, and the result of a careful study of ergonomics.

In the seating, the theme of the band of burnished painted aluminium, the fil rouge of the collection, is taken up again in a more leisurely rhythm to create the structure. The bending of the band draws the shape of the backrest and sled bases, with dynamic, agile and angular profiles.

A dense, handcrafted polypropylene rope cover is woven onto the metal frame in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow. In addition to the armchair and chairs, the range includes a large array of products, such as a dining table with seats, a stool, a comfortable sunbed, side tables and a bench.

products.title: Armchair - Petalo - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
With the Petalo armchair and pouf, Vincent Van Duysen enhances the Outdoor Timeout Collection with gentle curves and delicately enveloping seating. A testament to the artistry inherent in the collection, these designs create reimagine outdoor atmospheres thanks to their inviting aesthetic.

To achieve its abundant lightness, Petalo features a solid aluminum base in a distinctive merlot red color, carefully chosen for its recyclability. This aligns seamlessly with the Molteni Group's unwavering commitment to sustainability.

The backrest, available in high and low versions, becomes a canvas for the intricate dance of polypropylene fiber ribbons. These ropes, reminiscent of nautical elements, add a touch of elegance while being resistant to water and challenging climates.

The enveloping seat cushion caters to diverse aesthetic tastes and ergonomic needs. The low backrest version comes with small, padding-free yet comfortable cushions, while the high backrest version can be configured with a large spoke cushion that lines the frame’s perimeter, seamlessly integrating with the seat to elevate the level of comfort.

For added creativity, the comfortable pouf provides an additional surface, complementing the armchair and enhancing the overall outdoor experience.

A celebration of al fresco living through a harmonious blend of design, comfort, and sustainability, Petalo marks another iconic addition to Vincent Van Duysen's timeless vision for the Outdoor Collection.

products.title: Armchair - Boboli - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
A Vincent Van Duysen original, the Boboli armchair is an iconic and innovative creation characterized by its light and airy lines, seamlessly blending with the outdoor environment.

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Boboli chair showcases a solid teak wood frame and seat, perfectly capturing the fusion of nature and design embodied by Molteni&C Outdoor Collection. The backrest, woven by hand using polypropylene fiber ribbons in ecru employs superior craftsmanship to create a natural effect.

Allowing for a personalized touch, Boboli’s seat and back cushioning are fully customizable from an array of fabrics and colors meticulously curated by Marta Ferri.

A seamless marriage of form and function, the Boboli armchair combines with the sofa from the same family creating an elegant and comfortable retreat for outdoor living, further enriching the legacy of the Molteni&C design narrative.

products.title: Outdoor Armchair - D.154.2 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
One of Gio Ponti's most iconic and representative pieces, designed in 1954 for the Planchart collectors' villa in Caracas (1953-57), is now available in an outdoor version. The careful study of materials and technical performance guarantee not only respect for the valuable original design, but also the durability that characterises all Molteni&C products.

The D.154.2 is a wrap-around armchair with a sinuous profile, characterised by a rigid yet cosy shell juxtaposed with a soft upholstered counter frame. The essence of the chair originates from the subtle play of curved lines and the harmonious contrast between rigid and soft elements that make it timeless.

products.title: Armchair - D.150.5 - By Gio Ponti
products.description_html:
In collaboration with the Gio Ponti Archives and the heirs of the renowned Milanese architect, Molteni&C is reconstructing one of the rare pieces of furniture Gio Ponti designed for outdoor use: the D.150.5 chaise longue projects for the cruise ship Andrea Doria in 1952.

This edition is a tribute to Ponti's work for the Andrea Doria, where he was able to create exceptional environments with his multifaceted creativity. The chaise longue, "dreamed up" and designed by Ponti, is an important exponent of this representation, which anticipates, by seizing the opportunity of the ship's unconventional environments, precisely the continuous and modifiable spaces of his architecture of later years, where the furnishings participate in the domestic theatre without constructing fixed sets, as could be the case for living room or bedroom furniture, but rather responding to and representing in their design the comforts and needs of those who would use them.

A synthesis of values that resolves itself into an aesthetic, as Ponti teaches.
The contours of our chaise longue are characterised by two distinctive features: the first is the continuous line of the side design that unites the different parts (backrest, seat, armrest, footrest) in a single stroke, marking the elongated profile of the armchair in accordance with the Pontian principle.

The second detail is the radius of the angle between the seat and the backrest, which is identical to that of Ponti's precisely stated in the construction notes of the '53 Distex now issued by Molteni&C as D.153.1. The use of solid teak highlights the production merits of high quality cabinet making.

products.title: Armchair - Palinfrasca - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The themes that identify the Landmark Collection - the curved, enveloping lines of the solid teak frame and the macro-scale warp and weft pattern - remain in the armchair and, thanks to the more compact proportions, become even clearer and more expressive.

The curved backrest is like an embrace that envelops the user, enhancing the idea of protective and cosy comfort. As in the modular sofa elements, the backrest can be woven in teak or EVA polyurethane in olive green. As in the sofas, the seat cushioning provides enveloping comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Boboli - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
Extending the allure of the Boboli armchair, the two-seater sofa makes a significant debut in the Outdoor collection, boasting an enveloping and welcoming design that harmonizes with the generous and sensual shapes of the armchair.

Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Boboli sofa showcases a solid teak wood frame and seat, perfectly capturing the fusion of nature and design embodied by Molteni&C Outdoor Collection. The backrest, woven by hand using polypropylene fiber ribbons in ecru employs superior craftsmanship to create a natural effect.

Allowing for a personalized touch, Boboli’s seat and back cushioning are fully customizable from an array of fabrics and colors meticulously curated by Marta Ferri.

A seamless marriage of form and function, the Boboli sofa combines with the armchair from the same family creating an elegant and comfortable retreat for outdoor living, further enriching the legacy of the Molteni&C design narrative.

products.title: Sofa - Sway - By Yabu Pushelberg
products.description_html:
A visionary design for outdoor seating, Sway is a modular sofa system by the renowned Yabu Pushelberg. Drawing inspiration from a deep love for nature and an expert command of design, the Sway sofa redefines outdoor spaces with its versatility and fluid forms.

Bringing modularity outdoors, the Sway system is crafted from solid teak, ensuring durability and a natural finish. Characterized by a blend of curved and angular lines, Sway's multiple elements can be configured in a diverse array of possibilities, ensuring a dynamic and ever-changing outdoor experience.

Generously sized cushions create a rich and soft feel. Molded from polyurethane with variable densities, the seat cushions ensure maximum support that will not wane with time. Designed for outdoor environments, the upholstery is both weather-resistant and breathable. Despite their large dimensions, the cushion covers are easily removable for added convenience.

Offered in two sizes, the adjustable back cushions not only highlight the elegance of each element but also enhance the intricate woven pattern. Meticulously crafted, their design allows for easy customization, ensuring a harmonious fusion functionality and personalization.

The Sway modular system consists of eleven elements that can be artfully arranged to create a harmonious interplay of shapes and flowing lines. This ensemble features two chaise lounges, sofas in two dimensions (255 cm and 177 cm), a corner module for intricate configurations, a central element, four side terminals, and a serene island for ultimate relaxation.

The Sway pouf, with its compact dimensions, encapsulates the principles and technologies applied to the modular system. A series of coffee tables, available in three sizes, features the same aesthetic motifs as the Sway family, presenting a harmonious and customizable addition.

products.title: Sofa - Phoenix - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
A collection with a minimal and contemporary aesthetic that interprets elements of the Mediterranean tradition: fer forgé and hand woven polypropylene rope.

The Timeout Collection is characterised by the burnished painted aluminium band that frames all the profiles of the furniture like a ribbon, rounding off at the corners and thus creating, in a continuous stroke, the seat support, armrests and support feet. The latter, seen from the side, appear slender and light, giving a sense of dynamism.

The sofa is available in two versions, also with two cushions, with widths of 150 and 180 cm. The use of aluminium, which weighs significantly less than iron, allows for easy movement of generously sized furniture. The easy movement and reconfiguration of elements is an inherent feature of outdoor furniture.

The burnished painted aluminium structure, which creates a double curvature in the seat crosspiece to soften the edge, is highlighted by the polypropylene rope upholstery available in anthracite, olive green and desert yellow. It is a dense weave made entirely by hand, with a motif reminiscent of the Mediterranean tradition of baskets and panniers, which 'warms' the minimalism of the structure.

This is a material and colour contrast that makes the Timeout Collection contemporary and timelessly elegant. Refined and almost imperceptible dimensional correspondences give the furniture balance and harmony.
In addition to the sofa, the range includes a large array of products, such as armchairs, a dining table with seats, a stool, a comfortable sun , side tables and a bench.

products.title: Sofa - Palinfrasca - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Palinfrasca Sofa, with its immediately recognisable iconic shape, pays tribute to the 1994 work by Luca Meda from which it takes its inspiration, interpreting the essence of teak not only in an unprecedented and contemporary way, but also in the most exhaustive representation of Molteni&C's savoir-faire and research into materials: a knowledge gained in the almost ninety years of the life of the company, founded in 1934.

The Landmark Collection presents a modular system in solid teak, characterised by curved, soft, angular lines that give an intense feeling of comfort. The system is composed of a multiplicity of elements that can be placed side by side to create configurations that are always different, can be moved as desired, and can be reassembled.

The seats are rich in refined cabinet-making details, such as the profile cut into the connection between the end pillar of the structure and the back of the sofa, which serves as a convenient shelf for small objects. The solid wood pillar itself shows a soft, rounded profile and a double curvature in the corners that give the material a 'soft' image.

The gentle curves of the supportive frame, together with the silky smoothness of the wood, conjure up a general image of softness.

Another distinctive element of the Landmark Collection is the "weaving" of the thin backrest band, which recalls the weaves in natural materials of the Mediterranean tradition. There is a warp and weft motif on painted metal rods in a burnished colour, which, in a macro-scale design, lends an original and contemporary aesthetic. The backrest weave is available in teak or olive green EVA polyurethane, a pliable yet non-deformable plastic material with an appearance reminiscent of leather and salt- or weather-resistant characteristics suitable for outdoor furniture.

The sofa cushions are generous, giving an idea of abundance, softness and richness of materials. The seat cushion in moulded polyurethane with variable densities provides maximum support, for immersive comfort. The upholstery is in outdoor, draining and weather-resistant fabric. The covers are easily removable, despite the large dimensions.

The back cushions, which can be positioned freely and in the desired quantity, are available in two sizes. Their construction not only emphasises the formal purity of the individual elements and enhances the richness of the woven pattern, but also fulfils an effective ergonomic function that can be modulated and customised.

The series includes: sofas in three widths, end pieces in two different lengths and chaise longues, also in two lengths; a smaller sofa with a deep, immersive seat and a large, scenic circular island element, as well as an armchair and a pouffe.

products.title: Console Table - Remi - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Remi console is a meditation on material, form, and the power of craftsmanship.

The console was designed to be placed behind the new Augusto sofa to mirror its proportions and act as a counterweight to the upholstery’s soft volume. Made of coffee oak essence and available in 230x55cm with a height of 55 cm, Remi's elegant shape makes it suitable for a multitude of different layouts. Forming a unified design, the console’s subtle configuration is a testament to Molteni&C craftmanship and meticulous attention to detail.

  • (H): 55 cm

products.title: Bench - Aldgate - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
Aldgate Bench is designed to mirror the sophistication and unparalleled comfort of the Aldgate Bed by Rodolfo Dordoni. The bench features a removable outer cover crafted from bonded velveteen cotton blend and stands upon sleek, aluminum feet. Rodolfo Dordoni’s Aldgate Bench creates a cohesive and harmonious atmosphere in the bedroom.

In keeping with the Aldgate inspiration of soft lines and a subtle finish, the bench is designed as an isolated element that radiates autonomy and self-sufficiency. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Aldgate Bench seamlessly integrates with various bedroom settings, offering a versatile and stylish seating solution.

products.title: Bench - Azul Bench - By Nicola Gallizia
products.description_html:
Azul Bench expresses the value of craftsmanship that is evident in the processing of raw materials of the highest quality, dictated by seams performed with care and passion.

Powder coated steel structure completely covered in regenerated hide-leather in the colors of the Molteni&C range.

A single functional measure for all sizes of the Azul bed.

products.title: Bench - Tibeau - By GamFratesi
products.description_html:
The Tibeau bench by GamFratesi is a natural extension of the Tibeau bed, reinforcing its sculptural presence while adding functionality and versatility to the sleeping space. Designed with the same commitment to craftsmanship and material integrity, the bench embodies a dialogue between strength and softness, form and function.

Echoing the bold architectural language of the Tibeau bed, the bench features a solid wood frame, defined by clean lines and geometric precision. Its structure references historical and brutalist influences, balancing a sense of permanence with refined detailing. A generously padded seat cushion introduces an inviting contrast, softening the piece while ensuring comfort and practicality.

Perfectly aligned with the Tibeau bed’s aesthetic, the bench serves as a seamless companion, offering additional seating or a convenient surface within the bedroom. Whether placed alongside the bed or as a standalone accent, it upholds the timeless architectural presence that defines Molteni&C’s approach to contemporary living.
